title: The working database across devices
description: Clients, rates and documents are available in one connected history.

blocks.text: An invoice started on the phone is one you want to carry on with at the office, together with everything needed for it.

quote.text: I wish I was able to logon to my account from different devices. Currently I’m logged on to my account from cell phone but I’m unable to logon to the my account from my laptop or my iPad.

blocks.text: Keep documents and reference lists consistent with each other, show the changes that haven’t been sent. Don’t add one-off lines to the shared catalog without the user choosing to.
Updating a rate applies to new work and doesn’t rewrite old invoices.
